A/V Infrastructure Engineering builds infrastructure for Google's large conference rooms (50+ seating capacity), user experience labs, background audio sound systems, internal live stream and other services offered internally by the AV Engineering team.

positions.title: Infrastructure Engineer
positions.description: Site Operations Engineering is part of the Infrastructure Engineering organization. The team focuses on the availability and reliability of the hardware and software stack that the provide Fitbit services.

positions.title: Information Technology Resident
positions.description:
Google's Information Technology Residency Program (ITRP) is a 26-month role designed to jumpstart recent graduates' careers in technology. The core duty of the program involves helping Googlers on a variety of challenging support cases and includes working on all major desktop and mobile operating systems (Windows, OS X, Linux, Chrome OS, Android, etc). Interacting with people in all parts of the company will give you insight into a unique enterprise and corporate culture.

As part of the program, I spent a quarter-long rotation with Google Calendar Site Reliability Engineer team. I worked on monitoring framework migration, production releases,  and job deployment software.

I also contributed to new hire onboarding automation, which primarily consisted of working on a new web application designed to provide more reliable and quicker first day identity verifcation. This application leveraged skills with AppEngine using Python.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Protocol Buffers · Linux · Infrastructure
